title: Report on the simplification review of Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 (EUDR), COM(2026) 191 final
key_claim: Commission estimates simplification cuts annual EUDR compliance costs by about 75%, from EUR 8.1 billion to EUR 2.0 billion; downstream operators incur 5% of initial costs; Member States are encouraged to focus inspections on actors with most obligations; public enforcement cost was costed at around EUR 18 million per year; 275 thousand unique importing operators.
frame_summary: Frames the review as lightening the regime for most of the chain while keeping the full duty, and the inspection effort, on the first operator placing goods on the market.
